internal_static.source: the same released A1 train trajectories only
internal_static.selection: first indexed clip per unique system/replica; one midpoint frame from that clip
internal_static.strata: 62 eligible train systems x R1/R2/R3; 303--1000 atoms
internal_static.task: T=1 geometry reconstruction/denoising; no physical lag or motion label
internal_static.condition_coordinates_role: all coordinate-derived conditions are rebuilt from the perturbed frame

external_static.direct_overlap_policy: exclude exact PDB-chain origins matching released A train, valid, or sealed-test manifest IDs
external_static.reason: The user explicitly authorized this bounded version without strict homology filtering. Exact identity overlap and representation/quality gates remain fail-closed.

heldout_static_evaluation.external_vs_internal_output_mse_result: external PDB lower at all four sigmas; paired system-bootstrap CI95 below zero

limitations: The internal source tests an extra decoder task on a size-matched subset of dynamic train systems.
No sequence- or structure-level near-homology filtering is applied to the external corpus in this bounded version.
PDB structures provide geometry supervision only; they are not treated as Boltzmann population or motion-label samples.
